name: sim_harness_waits_are_bounded
description: The sim harness's waits end when what they wait for cannot come (M4: a test once looped until the machine ran out of memory). With the sequencer paused, play_out stops after one round that ran no tick, with an error, instead of spinning until the run's timeout; catch_up does the same when the turns a stalled client needs are gone, and takes at least one tick a call, so a per_call of 0 still catches up. With the sequencer running again, play_out goes on from where it stopped and the clients agree.

steps.msg: a paused sequencer: play_out stopped at once, the match neither over nor at its limit
a per_call of 0 catches up one tick a call
turns gone from the log: catch_up gives up with -1 instead of waiting forever
unpaused, play_out goes on from there and the clients agree
